source: src/cards/cards-data.js（唯一卡面事实源；中文卡文优先 textZh）

cards.name: Ghastly Revelation
cards.text: Discover 3 clues at your location. Give any number of your clues to another investigator, or place any number of your clues on any location. You are defeated and suffer 1 mental trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.textZh: 发现你所在地点的3个线索。将你任意数量的线索交给另一位调查员，或者在任意一个地点上放置你任意数量的线索。你被击败并承受1点精神创伤。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

cards.name: Studious
cards.text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 1 additional card in your opening hand.
cards.textZh:
永久。
每场游戏开始时，你的起始手牌中额外有一张卡牌。

cards.name: Small Favor
cards.text:
Deal 1 damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
[reaction] When you play Small Favor, increase its cost by 2: Change "Deal 1 damage" to "Deal 2 damage."
[reaction] When you play Small Favor, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."
cards.textZh:
对你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人造成1点伤害。
[reaction]在你打出帮个小忙时，提升其费用2点：“造成1点伤害”变为“造成2点伤害”。
[reaction]在你打出帮个小忙时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”。

cards.name: Another Day, Another Dollar
cards.text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 2 additional resources.
cards.textZh:
永久。
你每场游戏开始拥有额外2资源。

cards.name: Dayana Esperence
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[fast]: Attach a non-weakness [[Spell]] event from your hand to Dayana Esperence. Limit 1 event attached to her.
The attached event may be played as if it were in your hand. It is not placed in your discard pile after it is played (it remains attached). As an additional cost to play the attached event, exhaust Dayana Esperence and spend 1 secret.
cards.textZh:
使用(3秘密)。
[free]：将你手牌中的一张非弱点法术事件附属到黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯上。附属到其上的事件仅限1张。
可以打出附属的事件，如同其在你手牌中。其打出后，不放到你的弃牌堆(其仍附属在原处)。作为打出附属的事件的额外费用，横置黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯并花费1秘密。

cards.name: Deny Existence
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an encounter card or enemy attack would cause you to do one of the following (choose one): Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror.
You ignore that aspect of the effect. Then, perform the opposite of that aspect (draw cards, gain resources, gain additional actions, heal damage, or heal horror, respectively).
cards.textZh:
快速。在遭遇卡牌或敌人攻击将要导致你执行以下一项(选择一项)时打出：弃掉手牌、失去资源、失去行动、受到伤害、受到恐惧。
你忽略该效果的影响。然后，对应地执行与之相反的效果(抽取卡牌、获得资源、获得额外行动、治愈伤害、治愈恐惧)。

cards.name: Trial by Fire
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose one of your skills. Until the end of your turn, set the base value of that skill to 5.
cards.textZh: 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。选择你一项技能。直到你回合结束，将该技能的基础值设为5。

cards.name: Bait and Switch
cards.text:
Either (choose one):
- Evade. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], evade the enemy and move it to a connecting location.
- Evade. Use only on a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. If you succeed, evade that enemy and switch locations with it.
cards.textZh:
选择一项：
- 躲避。如果你检定成功，且躲避的敌人非[[精英]]，躲避该敌人并将其移动到一个连接地点。
- 躲避。只用于在连接地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。如果你检定成功，躲避该敌人并与其交换地点。

cards.name: Anna Kaslow
cards.text:
You have 2 additional tarot slots.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Anna Kaslow is in your opening hand: Put her into play.
[reaction] After Anna Kaslow enters play: Search your deck for a [[Tarot]] asset and put it into play.
cards.textZh:
你拥有额外2个塔罗牌槽位。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果安娜·卡斯洛在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
[reaction]在安娜·卡斯洛入场后：查找你的牌库，找出一张[[塔罗]]支援，并将其放置入场。

cards.name: Hallowed Mirror
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Forced - After Hallowed Mirror enter play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Soothing Melody. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck. When Hallowed Mirror leaves play, find each of those copies of Soothing Melody (even if they are out of play) and set them aside, out of play.
cards.textZh:
每套牌库仅限一张。
强制 - 在圣化之镜入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张舒缓旋律。将其中一张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。在圣化之镜离场时，找到所有这些舒缓旋律（即使在场外），将它们放在一边，位于场外。

cards.name: Soothing Melody
cards.text:
Bonded (Hallowed Mirror).
Heal 2 damage or 2 horror (or any combination thereof) from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location. Draw 1 card.
cards.textZh:
绑定(圣化之镜)。
治愈你所在地点的调查员和/或[[盟友]]支援的2点伤害或2点恐惧(或者以任意方式组合，总计2点)。抽取1张卡牌。

cards.name: "I've had worse…"
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 2 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Then, gain that many resources.
cards.textZh:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多2点。然后，获得同等数量的资源。

cards.name: Occult Lexicon
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Forced - After Occult Lexicon enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Blood-Rite. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck. When Occult Lexicon leaves play, find each of those copies of Blood-Rite (even if they are out of play) and set them aside, out of play.
cards.textZh:
每套牌库仅限1张
强制 - 在密教辞典入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张鲜血仪式。将其中1张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。在密教辞典离场时，找到所有这些鲜血仪式(即使在场外)，将它们放在一边，位于场外。

cards.name: Blood-Rite
cards.text:
Bonded (Occult Lexicon).
Draw 2 cards. Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. For each card thusly discarded, you may either gain 1 resource, or spend 1 resource to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.textZh:
绑定(密教辞典)。
抽取2张卡牌。弃掉你最多2张手牌。每有一张卡牌因此被弃掉，你可以获得1资源，或者花费1资源来对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

cards.name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
cards.text: Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Draw cards until you reach your maximum hand-size. Remove Glimpse the Unthinkable from the game.
cards.textZh: 将你手牌中任意数量的非弱点卡牌洗入你的牌库。抽取卡牌，直至手牌数量达到上限。将窥看不思议之事从游戏中移除。

cards.name: "You owe me one!"
cards.text: Look at another investigator's hand. You may play a non-weakness card in that investigator's hand, under your control. If you do, you and that investigator each draw 1 card.
cards.textZh: 查看另一位调查员的手牌。你可以打出该调查员手牌中的一张非弱点卡牌，置于你的控制之下。如果你这么做，你和该调查员都抽取1张卡牌。

cards.name: Double, Double
cards.text:
Exceptional.
[reaction] After you play an event, exhaust Double, Double: Play that event again as if it were in your hand.
cards.textZh:
卓越。
[reaction]在你打出一张事件后，横置超级加倍：再次打出该事件，如同其在你手牌中。

cards.name: Wither
cards.text: [action]: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] for this attack. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during this attack, the attacked enemy gets -1 fight, -1 health, and -1 evade for the remainder of the turn (to a minimum of 1).
cards.textZh: [action]：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次攻击得到+2[willpower]。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，被攻击敌人在本回合剩余时间内得到-1攻击值、-1生命值和-1躲避值，最低减至1。

cards.name: Sixth Sense
cards.text: [action]: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this investigation. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during this test, you may choose a revealed location up to 2 connections away from your current location; you are now investigating as if you were at the chosen location in addition to your location (you may use either shroud value).
cards.textZh: [action]：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次调查得到+2[willpower]。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，你可以选择与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的一个已揭示地点；如同你在所在地点调查的同时，也在所选地点调查(你可以使用两个地点中任意一个地点的隐藏值)。

cards.name: Lure
cards.text:
Attach to your location or to a connecting location.
During the enemy phase, each enemy that moves does so along the shortest path toward the attached location, instead of to where it would normally move.
 Forced - While attached, at the end of the round: Discard Lure.
cards.textZh:
附属到你所在地点或一个连接地点。
敌军阶段期间，所有要移动的敌人不照常移动，而是改为沿着最短路径，朝附属地点移动。
强制 - 附属在地点时，当一轮结束时：弃掉诱敌深入。

cards.name: Eucatastrophe
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you reveal a chaos token that would reduce your skill value to 0 during a skill test (including the [auto_fail] token).
Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead.
cards.textZh:
快速。在技能检定期间，你揭示一个混乱标记，且该标记将要令你的技能值减少到0时打出(包括[auto_fail]标记)。
取消该标记并改为将其视作[elder_sign]标记。
